paths.name: @hono/node-server
paths.message: Import serveHono from @conciv/serve, never @hono/node-server's serve — the wrapper bakes overrideGlobalObjects:false so a co-hosted engine never clobbers the host's global Response/Request (which breaks SSR realms, e.g. nitro rendering [object Response]). upgradeWebSocket may be imported directly.

paths.name: @effect/platform-node
paths.message: Import @effect/platform-node by subpath (@effect/platform-node/NodeFileSystem and the like), never the bare barrel: it loads about 770 extra modules, a redis client among them, into every engine process.

paths.name: @tanstack/solid-query
paths.message: Import TanStack Query from @conciv/client, never @tanstack/solid-query directly. @conciv/client bundles the one solid-query + query-core copy the widget and every plugin share, and that copy carries our TanStack/query#11230 patch; a direct import resolves a second, unpatched copy with its own QueryClient context and onlineManager.
